text:
alex_w: heads up, deploybot flagged engine bundle throughput anomaly in the night-slice pool. seeing bursty p95 and a couple of OOMs during the 2% traffic slice.

maya_p: which bundle? can you paste the deploy id/release tag?

alex_w: deploybot shows: `engine-bundle-2026-03-kvv5` rolled to 2% across night-slice region at 02:10. logs show a KV marshalling spike and a couple of CUDA OOMs on node g4-night-12.

sasha_r: ugh. looks like the new kernel path took a different memory layout. did they enable the matmul v2 tiled path?

jamie_t: last perf bench looked fine but their test sequences were shorter. production seq len tails exposed the issue.

alex_w: propose immediate mitigation: pause further slices, pin traffic back to `engine-bundle-2026-02-kv-stable` for affected allocs, and run a targeted bake with longer seq lens. thoughts?

maya_p: +1 to pause. can deploybot do a rollback pin automatically? what TTL do we want on the pin?

deploybot: @channel automated action available: `pin-version --target=night-slice --version=engine-bundle-2026-02-kv-stable --ttl=6h`

alex_w: let's use 6h TTL to buy time for a deeper triage. schedule an ops handoff in 15.

jamie_t: rollback criteria suggestion: if p95 latency increases >30% over baseline OR OOM count >=2 in 10m window OR error-rate >1.5% sustained for 5m, then immediately pin and open an incident.

sasha_r: add a check for cold-start fails (failed warmstart >3 in 15m) too — that was present in our trace.

maya_p: okay i'll paste release-note snippet to push to #release-notes after we determine final action: 
```
Release note (draft): Engine bundle 2026-03-kvv5 introduces tiled matmul path and optimized KV layout. Expected improvements for short sequences; longer sequences may see increased memory use until tiled allocator refinements land. Rolling out to limited traffic. If you see regressions, contact eng-runtime.
```

alex_w: can opsbot run a quick smoke-run command across 4 nodes with seq len 4k and 8k and capture p95/p99 and resident memory?

opsbot: smoke-run queued. command: `ops smoke --bundle engine-bundle-2026-03-kvv5 --nodes=4 --seqlens=4096,8192 --dur=300s --collect=mem,p95,p99,ooms` — results ETA ~7m.

jamie_t: if smoke-run reproduces, we'll do an immediate pin and kick a canary rebuild with allocator tweak. if not, maybe the OOMs were unlucky thermal/gpu fragmentation.

alex_w: starting the 15m ops handoff now on video. tagging @maya_p @sasha_r @jamie_t. please add any quick-run adhoc checks to the handoff thread. :white_check_mark: 

opsbot: smoke-run complete: seq=4096 p95 +12% mem +8% no OOMs; seq=8192 p95 +42% mem +28% 2 OOMs on g4-night-12. Full logs: https://internal.run/smoke/1732467890.

maya_p: confirms reproduction on 8k. pin now?

alex_w: pinning via deploybot: `pin-version --target=night-slice --version=engine-bundle-2026-02-kv-stable --ttl=6h --reason="OOMs at 8k seqlen on kvv5"`

deplybot_typo: (bot mis-typed)

deploybot: executed: pin successful. affected slices reverted. Notifying routing to shift weights back within 60s.

sasha_r: thanks. i'll start a debug build with tiled-allocator fallback disabled and a patch to early-kv-free to reduce resident set. will attach CI perf snapshots.

jamie_t: also please add a small section to the release notes: what went wrong and how we reverted. convo draft: "Rolled engine-bundle-2026-03-kvv5 from night-slice due to memory pressure on long sequences; reverted to previous stable bundle while we publish a targeted fix."

maya_p: i'll craft the brief and post to #release-notes + #customer-commms after we have the regression PR link.

alex_w: closing the thread for now — pinned TTL 6h so ops can monitor. if metrics look stable, we'll unpin and retry with a smaller micro-slice and longer bake after the allocator patch.

opsbot: monitoring channel subscribed. will alert if p95 > baseline * 1.25 for 10m or OOMs >0 in 5m.
